correctness.rationale: All connected induced sets are precisely single-arm nonempty intervals or center-containing independent triples of arm prefixes, giving the exact count. Three leaves are shattered; among any four marked vertices one lies between two others, so VC=3. The all-m Ldim lower bound is three independent balanced prefix-length binary searches. Exact online dimension uses the exhaustive recurrence P_k(H) iff some vertex divides H into two depth k-1 feasible sides; concept cardinality and symmetry pruning are sound. Independently enumerated m1..5 and their Ldim; for m12 independently evaluated all 13 root positions up to arm-permutation symmetry for depth10, using 44,411 memoized states; in every case one child fails depth9, while the product-threshold construction gives depth9. The inspected source enumerators and full m1..12 table establish first m12 threshold, not an unsupported infinite assertion.
